cis_text.title: Classify Service Providers

ai_guidance.llm: Classify each approved AI service provider by authorized data classifications. Classification ensures alignment between sensitivity levels and provider assurances.
ai_guidance.agent: Classify agent-related service providers based on the sensitivity of data they process and the criticality of the agent functions they support. Enable risk-based management of providers. For example, high-risk providers (e.g., those hosting core memory or models) receive more scrutiny and stricter controls.
ai_guidance.mcp: Classify external service providers and third-party MCP servers by the sensitivity of systems and data they access. Apply proportional security requirements based on classification level.

limits: A claim shows that a control can mitigate a technique. It does not show that an implementation is effective.
'none' or 'no_row' means the mapping has no mitigating control. It does not mean that no defence exists.
Claims use ATT&CK Enterprise 16.1, the version that the source mapping uses. See later_version for changes in newer versions.
CIS claims (cis_claims and cis/safeguards) use ATT&CK Enterprise 19.1, the version that the CIS mapping uses.
